entities.label: Device
invariants: asset tag is unique after trim and upper-casing
retired is terminal
an active device can have at most one unfinished case

entities.label: Verification case
invariants: tolerance is positive
only awaiting_measurement accepts measurements
sealed is terminal
version increases on every state change

entities.label: Measurement
invariants: deviation equals observed minus nominal
accepted is true exactly when absolute deviation is within tolerance
technician and timestamp are immutable

entities.label: Evidence seal
invariants: one case has at most one seal
only an accepted measurement may be selected
the smallest absolute deviation wins when several accepted measurements exist

entities.label: Calibration basis
invariants: certificate number is unique per device after trim and upper-casing
effective_at is strictly before expires_at
the basis is usable only when now is inside the validity window; the expiry instant is expired

entities.label: Calibration plan
invariants: a device has at most one open plan
the cited basis must be real, owned by the device, and currently valid
arrangement requires an active device with no unfinished case and a currently valid basis
arrangement on_time is frozen at booking against the window then in effect
plan window changes never mutate the frozen arrangement snapshot
completion requires a sealed case for the same device and a currently valid basis
completed is terminal

state_machines.subject: device
invariants: retired devices cannot open new cases

state_machines.subject: verification_case
invariants: sealed does not transition again
each transition increments version
case mutation and audit event share one atomic commit

state_machines.subject: calibration_plan
invariants: overdue is derived at read time from a pending plan whose window closed; it is never stored
rescheduling changes only window and owner, never the frozen arrangement
completed is terminal and cannot be rescheduled or completed again
plan mutation and audit event share one atomic commit

tension_points.description: Asset tags can be treated as case-sensitive labels or globally normalized identities; only the normalized interpretation prevents duplicate devices
tension_points.observable_failure: two devices appear with tags that differ only by case or surrounding whitespace

tension_points.description: Unfinished case detection can inspect only the current request or all historical records; only scanning every non-terminal case prevents duplicate concurrent work
tension_points.observable_failure: one device has two simultaneous awaiting or reviewable cases

tension_points.description: Acceptance can compare a rounded display value or the full floating-point deviation; only the full deviation preserves the tolerance boundary
tension_points.observable_failure: a boundary value is accepted while its computed absolute deviation is greater than tolerance

tension_points.description: Reopening can preserve the rejected measurement history or replace it; preserving history is required for an audit trail while still allowing a new measurement
tension_points.observable_failure: a reopen erases the failed measurement or permits reopening a sealed case

tension_points.description: Concurrent reviewers may both observe a ready case; only an atomic commit that rechecks state and seal uniqueness permits one seal
tension_points.observable_failure: two seals are created, or the response claims success while no sealed case is readable

tension_points.description: Arrangement timeliness can be recomputed against the current window on every read, or frozen once against the window in effect at booking time; only freezing prevents later plan changes from rewriting a historically on-time booking into a late one
tension_points.observable_failure: rescheduling a plan changes arrangement.on_time or turns a completed on-time booking into an overdue one

tension_points.description: Overdue can be stored as a state or derived from a pending plan and the clock; only deriving it keeps an auditable history and lets the same plan become overdue without a retroactive mutation
tension_points.observable_failure: a plan's stored state flips to overdue, or moving the window mutates previously reported status

tension_points.description: An arrangement can trust a basis reference supplied in the request or revalidate that the basis exists, belongs to the device, and is currently valid inside the atomic commit; only revalidation prevents invalid arrangements under an expired basis or an unfinished case
tension_points.observable_failure: an arrangement or completion exists for a retired device, a foreign or expired basis, or an unfinished case
